risks.risk: Hidden structural damage such as cracks, buckles, or previous weld repairs.

proof_requests: Photo of all four rims together to confirm it is a set.
Photo of the size and offset stamps on the back of the rim.
Photo of the manufacturer markings on the back to verify authenticity.
Video of the rim on a balancer to check for buckles or bends.
response.reason: The diameter (size) and the quantity (whether it is a single rim or a set of four) are not shown and are required to determine even a base price.
